## Audit Complete

1. **new/dart-gen-bs/gen_app_panuy_ent1.dart:51** · Wrong index in save method: `_m_abs((num.tryParse(_v[8] ?? '') ?? 0))` will always compute 0 for new records because _v[8] (the intermediate הפרש רוחב value) is never populated when creating—the _v map only has indices {4,5,7} initially. Should compute directly from base inputs: `_m_abs((num.tryParse(_v[2] ?? '') ?? 0) - (num.tryParse(_v[4] ?? '') ?? 0))`. · **P1 wrong result** · Replace line 51's c24 computation.

2. **new/dart-gen-bs/gen_app_panuy_ent1.dart:175** · Display also uses wrong index: same bug in the build method's _calc call. Will show 0 for new records being entered. · **P1 wrong result** · Same fix on line 175.

- All 14 generated files compile; police report confirms 0 errors and 1 abs() call
